basic_details.job_title: Tis Hazari Court Delhi Court Auctioneer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Legal practitioners practising at Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi with a standing of at least five years or more at the Bar and a gross professional income of Rs.6 lakhs or more per annum
qualification.details: Qualification: Legal practitioners practising at Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi who have a standing of at least five years or more at the Bar and have a Gross Professional income of Rs.6 lakhs or more per annum Experience: Standing of at least five years or more at the Bar | Other conditions: | Only Legal Practitioners practising at Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi may apply Standing of at least five years or more at the Bar Gross Professional income of Rs.6 lakhs or more per annum Criteria fixed as per direction of the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi, New Delhi

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed proforma enclosed as Annexure-A, addressed to the Principal District & Sessions Judge (HQs), Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.
Paste a latest passport size photograph on the form and sign it.
Attach the reference in the prescribed format Annexure-B and the documents listed in Annexure-A.
Make sure the application reaches the R & I Branch, Central District, Room No. 204, Second Floor, Main Court Building, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi on or before 16.11.2026 at 04:00 PM.
important_instructions: Application received after the stipulated date and time shall not be entertained Form asks whether the applicant was earlier appointed as Court Auctioneer by this Court or by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi, with details Reference of two Advocates of ten years standing or other responsible persons intimately knowing the applicant is asked in column 12 Applicant may state any special reason in support of the application (column 13)

content_sections.text: Last date: 16 November 2026 Vacancies: 2 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: No application fee is mentioned in the notification Place: Tis Hazari Court Complex, Delhi

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Legal practitioners practising at Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi who have a standing of at least five years or more at the Bar and have a Gross Professional income of Rs.6 lakhs or more per annum Experience: Standing of at least five years or more at the Bar Other conditions: Only Legal Practitioners practising at Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi may apply Standing of at least five years or more at the Bar Gross Professional income of Rs.6 lakhs or more per annum Criteria fixed as per direction of the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi, New Delhi

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application (04:00 PM)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational documents Self-attested copy of enrollment certificate Income proof: copy of latest ITR of previous 02 financial years along with affidavit Latest original experience certificate issued from Delhi Bar Association Letter of recommendation issued by an Advocate having 10 years of experience at Bar (Annexure-B)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for THC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed proforma enclosed as Annexure-A, addressed to the Principal District & Sessions Judge (HQs), Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi. Paste a latest passport size photograph on the form and sign it. Attach the reference in the prescribed format Annexure-B and the documents listed in Annexure-A. Make sure the application reaches the R & I Branch, Central District, Room No. 204, Second Floor, Main Court Building, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi on or before 16.11.2026 at 04:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Application received after the stipulated date and time shall not be entertained Form asks whether the applicant was earlier appointed as Court Auctioneer by this Court or by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi, with details Reference of two Advocates of ten years standing or other responsible persons intimately knowing the applicant is asked in column 12 Applicant may state any special reason in support of the application (column 13)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for THC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in THC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Court Auctioneer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for THC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-A (application proforma, page 3) and Annexure-B (Letter of Recommendation, page 4) of this notice) and send it to R & I Branch, Central District, Room No. 204, Second Floor, Main Court Building, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi, by by hand or post to the specified office address, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Legal practitioners practising at Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi with a standing of at least five years or more at the Bar and a gross professional income of Rs.6 lakhs or more per annum.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Legal Practitioners practising at Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi may apply. Standing of at least five years or more at the Bar. Gross Professional income of Rs.6 lakhs or more per annum. Criteria fixed as per direction of the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tis Hazari Court Complex, Delhi.

faq.answer: Self-attested copies of educational documents; Self-attested copy of enrollment certificate; Income proof: copy of latest ITR of previous 02 financial years along with affidavit; Latest original experience certificate issued from Delhi Bar Association; Letter of recommendation issued by an Advocate having 10 years of experience at Bar (Annexure-B).
